notes.text: The actual Davidson Sukkah 15b and Chagigah 5a paragraphs explicitly name Rabbi Ami bar Tavyomi and Rav Bardala bar Tavyomi respectively. The collective heading is Hyman’s grouping by patronymic, not evidence of one shared father or an exhaustive modern identity grouping.
